name: SDIC Power Holdings Co., Ltd
summary: SDIC Power Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the electricity generation business in China. The company generates electricity through hydropower, thermal power, solar power, onshore wind power, offshore wind power, energy storage, and electricity sales. It generates electricity with an installed capacity of 44.6347 GW, including 21.3045 GW of hydropower; 13,074.8 MW of thermal power; 4,140.3 MW of wind power; 7,689.4 MW of solar power; and 686.6 MW of energy storage. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Beijing, China. SDIC Power Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of State Development & Investment Corp., Ltd.
